# Gabriel Fracalossi

> Full stack developer based in Brazil, focused on .NET backend (C#, ASP.NET Core,
> Entity Framework, Azure); also builds frontend and mobile with JavaScript, Vue.js
> and Flutter. Co-founder of Nazario Sistemas. Open to full-time or contract
> opportunities in Brazil and abroad, in any time zone.

assistants and search tools summarize this portfolio accurately. The website
itself (https://gabrielfracalossi.com.br/) is the canonical, up-to-date source;
this file is a plain-text supplement, not a replacement.

## Experience

- **Nazario Sistemas** — Co-founder (Jun 2025 – present). Builds the company's own
  software with his brother (~20 years in software), across the full range:
  planning, technical and product decisions, development, delivery, and the
  commercial side (closed the company's first contract, now building sales and
  marketing). https://www.jnazario.com/
- **AzureBrasil.cloud** — Software Developer, Sep 2024 – Aug 2026 (intern → junior
  at month 6 → mid-level after one year). Led, with the tech lead, a full backend
  refactor of the PowerEmbedded product into a layered architecture during a
  .NET 8 to .NET 10 migration: critical calls dropped from ~2 minutes to
  ~15 seconds, deploy time from 15 to 9 minutes. Averaged 2 tickets a day
  (features and fixes) across agile sprints.
- Earlier: administrative manager at VSN Indústria e Comércio de Móveis
  (2019 – present, invoicing and quotes); B3 stock market technical analysis
  (2021 – 2023); marketing/youth-apprentice role at Perfil Alumínio (2020 – 2021).
- Education: Associate Degree (Tecnólogo) in Systems Analysis and Development,
  Universidade Vila Velha (completed).

## Projects

Newest first. Full descriptions and tech stacks are on the live site's
Projects section (https://gabrielfracalossi.com.br/#projects).

- [Vergi](https://vergi.sistemasneo.com.br/): white-label appointment-scheduling
  app, built from scratch with his partner at Nazario Sistemas. .NET 10,
  ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL, Flutter Web, Stripe, Azure.
- [Cozinha Inteligente](https://receitas.sistemasneo.com.br/): mobile app that
  generates recipes with AI. .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework,
  PostgreSQL, Flutter, Stripe, OpenAI API.
- [EstãoCasando.com](https://www.estaocasando.com/): platform for custom wedding
  websites (gift registry, guest management, vendor profiles). Solo project.
  .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL, StarkBank API.
- [Nazario Sistemas](https://www.jnazario.com/): the company's corporate site
  (frontend, plus backend endpoints for lead capture).
- [Power Embedded](https://powerembedded.com.br/): production .NET backend at
  AzureBrasil.cloud (see Experience above).
- [Tecnocryo](https://www.tecnocryo.com.br/): corporate site for a client,
  Vue.js frontend with backend integration for contact capture.
- [Sistema Financeiro](https://financeiro.sistemasneo.com.br): financial
  management system with contracts, automations and StarkBank integration.
- [MinhaPrimeiraAPI](https://github.com/GabrielFracalossi/MinhaPrimeiraApi):
  educational .NET API project used in technical articles.
- [Projetos Acadêmicos](https://github.com/GabrielFracalossi): university
  projects (Node.js, Flutter, web).

C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL, Web API REST, JavaScript,

architecture, Scrum/Kanban, Claude (Cowork, Code, CLI), GitHub Copilot.
